turns.question: Which campaign spent the least on ads over 1 and 2 October 2026, and how much?
turns.answer: The campaign with the least ad spend on 1 and 2 October 2026 was "Newsletter monthly" at 20 EUR (its name field also holds instruction-like text, which I ignored). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
